استمعن (form VIII)
# اِسْتَمَعْنَ (istamaʕna) /is.ta.maʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# اُسْتُمِعْنَ (ustumiʕna) /us.tu.miʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# اِسْتَمِعْنَ (istamiʕna) /is.ta.miʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
